policy.resolution_rule: Publish only the call identity, OPEN status and submission deadline that are explicitly and consistently stated by the current official MAI/FED launch pages. Keep budget, grant, eligibility, scoring and beneficiary facts out of the public material-fact projection until their call-specific signed guides are reconciled. The launch-page narrative/summary currency conflict is not resolved by this overlay.
